text.12:30: And women in the city said: The ruler's wife is asking of her slave-boy an ill-deed. Indeed he has smitten her to the heart with love. We behold her in plain aberration.
text.18:60: And when Moses said unto his servant: I will not give up until I reach the point where the two rivers meet, though I march on for ages.
text.18:62: And when they had gone further, he said unto his servant: Bring us our breakfast. Verily we have found fatigue in this our journey.
